title: `OmoVault` malicious accounts can permanently disable the vault
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  - The `OmoVault` contract allows whitelisted users to register accounts (`OmoAgent`) without requiring approval from the vault owner or manager.   A malicious actor can exploit this by registering an `OmoAgent` account that is configured with an invalid oracle for price retrieval, this would cause the `OmoVault.totalAssets()` function to revert whenever it is called, leading to a **permanent denial of service (DoS) for the vault**:  ```javascript function totalAssets() public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
